gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically proven adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum which is MMR-d by IHC or MSI-H by PCR (or microsatellite testing if routine practice).

The benefits of immunotherapy as a treatment prior to surgery to remove the tumour (neoadjuvant treatment) has been observed in both melanoma and in glioblastoma with enhanced local and systemic anti-tumour responses.

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of the trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of pembrolizumab (Study IMP) in patients with high risk Stage 2 or Stage 3 MMR-deficient colorectal cancer stratified with tumour mutation burden status.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The main question the researcher wants to investigate is whether pembrolizumab given prior to having surgery delays or prevents the cancer from coming back in advanced colorectal cancer patients with MSI-H or MMR-d.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Blood, tissue, mouth swabs and stool samples will be collected from patients throughout the trial to better understand the biology of immunotherapy as a treatment for CRC prior to surgery.

role_evidence.quote: Dose: 200mg by IV infusion on Day 1 of each treatment cycle

The purpose of the trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of pembrolizumab (Study IMP) in patients with high risk Stage 2 or Stage 3 MMR-deficient colorectal cancer stratified with tumour mutation burden status.

coder_notes: Colorectal cancer trial; glioblastoma is mentioned only in the brief summary/detailed description as background on neoadjuvant immunotherapy, not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arms, so not_glioblastoma (fails S5). Remaining fields coded for completeness. Both arms (OTHER) receive pembrolizumab; TMB status after cycle 1 determines whether two further cycles are given (TMB used to assign arm/cycles, coded enrichment). treatment_setting refers to primary (neoadjuvant, pre-surgery) CRC.
